message.content: The Declaration of Independence was officially adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**, but the formal signing ceremony took place later—**August 2, 1776**. The July date marks when the document was approved and printed, while August 2 is when the delegates affixed their signatures to the parchment.
